create_arcee_causal_lm: create an ArceeForCausalLM model instance from a HuggingFace LlamaConfig for autoregressive text generation
build_arcee_decoder_layer: build an ArceeDecoderLayer with attention, MLP, and RMSNorm for transformer block processing
run_arcee_forward: run a forward pass on the Arcee model with input IDs, positions, and a forward batch for inference
load_arcee_weights: load pretrained weights into an ArceeForCausalLM model with stacked QKV projection handling
apply_arcee_relu2_activation: apply the ReLU-squared activation function used by the Arcee MLP instead of SwiGLU
